scope: Five UK rental portals; permanently free local installable skill run by the user’s own agent; no hosted worker, shared scraped database or payments.
method: Official terms, help and API/partner documentation read through web research. No accounts, provider contacts, paid access, listing API requests, crawler execution, model experiments or runtime policy changes.
interpretation: Provider terms, statutory rights and technical accessibility are separate. Restricted_by_published_terms is not a court judgment; not_established is neither permission nor a declaration of illegality.

Public visibility, search-engine indexing, robots absence and third-party scraper availability do not establish a licence. OnTheMarket robots is considered because its terms explicitly incorporate it.
An alert subscription authorises delivery; a mailbox connector’s user permission only addresses mailbox access. It does not independently grant portal content extraction/reuse rights.
No fully verified end-to-end automatic discovery, reading and private-report licence was established across all five sites.
Original advertiser pages must be independently assessed; finding the same property elsewhere does not license a copy taken from a portal.
No source documents establish that removing fees changes the automation permissions. API eligibility or price is unknown unless stated.
Clause numbers for OpenRent and SpareRoom follow their nested numbered lists; named headings and paraphrases identify the precise provision.

providers.name: Rightmove

sources.title: Terms of use; page states updated February 2026
sources.evidence: Automated access, collection and interaction are restricted. Without Legal-team written consent, information access requires direct human interaction. Offered downloads are limited to service use; broader copying/storage needs consent. Software links and embedded assets also require consent; homepage linking has conditions. Personal registration is free for adults.

sources.title: How to register for property alerts
sources.evidence: A free account can save a search and receive email alerts instantly, daily, every three days or weekly.

sources.title: How the Property Alerts work
sources.evidence: An email body contains at most 14 matching new/reduced listings. Additional matches are represented by a count and a link back to search, so the email body is not a complete feed.

sources.title: Automated Datafeed specifications
sources.clause: Realtime Datafeed; ADF Guide; testing/go-live process
sources.evidence: Documented interfaces send and remove the participating advertiser’s properties and retrieve its branch property list. Integration/testing and member-branch go-live steps are described. This is an upload/member interface, not permission to search the full rental catalogue.

sources.title: API documentation: get started
sources.evidence: Documentation describes account/app registration and API credentials; this does not establish consumer rental-search eligibility.

sources.title: Property Risk Alerts
sources.clause: Delivery via online platform or API
sources.evidence: A professional property-risk product offers platform/API delivery. The page does not establish a free, general rental-discovery feed or this skill’s eligibility.

user_directed_agent_browser.note: An AI operating a browser is not expressly exempted from the direct-human requirement.

reuse.note: Do not equate private caching, report reproduction or software deeplinks with the offered-download allowance.

api.note: A third-party scraper subscription would not itself prove Rightmove authorisation.

alerts.note: Subscription is verified; permission for an agent to extract/reuse the delivered content is not established.

export_feed.note: No official consumer rental CSV/RSS/feed licence verified in this bounded review.

access_eligibility_and_fees.adf: Advertiser/member branch and integration process; fees unknown.
access_eligibility_and_fees.property_risk_api: Professional product; this use case’s eligibility and price unknown.

recommended_access.now: Use the provider’s own subscribed alert service for discovery. For an agent-produced report, prefer the same property’s original advertiser source if that source separately permits the intended access and reuse.
recommended_access.no_paste_candidate: The user can authorise their own mail connector to access received alerts; treat content extraction/reuse as unresolved, and do not automatically follow portal links.
recommended_access.licensed_route: A specific written licence covering local agents, discovery/read, temporary copies, private reports and links would resolve the missing portal permissions; no request was sent.

uncertainty: No end-to-end licensed local-agent route established.
API terms page returned no extractable body in this research tool; no licence conclusion relies on its unseen content.
Original advertiser access is an independent source audit, not an exception to portal terms.
providers.legal_status: Published provider wording and bounded research findings; not a judicial enforceability determination or declaration of illegality.

providers.name: Zoopla

sources.title: Terms of Use
sources.clause: Headings: How you may use content on our Site; No text or data mining, or web scraping
sources.evidence: Terms restrict conducting or facilitating automated access, copying, monitoring and analytical mining, expressly subject to non-excludable applicable law. Personal attributed extracts are allowed, without modification or separating images from text. Commercial use needs a licence; the adjacent AI-development wording does not establish a blanket prohibition of every personal AI use.

sources.title: How do I create email alerts and saved searches?
sources.clause: Website saved searches; creating email alerts from saved searches
sources.evidence: Signed-in users can save Buy/Rent searches and set email notifications; the app also offers instant push notifications. The guide says there is no limit on the number of email alerts.

sources.title: Premium Listings: Tech documentation
sources.evidence: The documented API activates Premium Listings for a customer’s properties. Product permissions/authentication are required. It is not a consumer interface for downloading all rental listings.

sources.title: Zoopla Member Support: APIs
sources.evidence: The official member-support index links Premium Listings APIs.

sources.title: Getting Started with Zoopla
sources.evidence: The official page opened but returned no extractable body. Its current public search-API availability or retirement could not be verified from that response.

automation.note: Free distribution does not supply a terms exemption.

user_directed_agent_browser.note: User instruction does not by itself remove the automated-method restriction.

reuse.note: The extract allowance does not itself authorise the automated collection step or unrestricted cache/report/image reuse.

api.note: No reliance on old developer keys or third-party claims that an API has closed.

alerts.note: A received email is a possible no-paste input; third-party automated processing/reuse permission is not established.

export_feed.note: Saved searches and product APIs are not a verified consumer export/feed licence.

access_eligibility_and_fees.human_site: Site access is stated free in zp-terms.
access_eligibility_and_fees.alerts: Signed-in user; no separate alert price stated in reviewed guide.
access_eligibility_and_fees.premium_api: Customer product permissions; pricing and this skill’s eligibility unknown.

recommended_access.now: Use official saved-search emails/push and independently licensed original-agent sources for report data.
recommended_access.no_paste_candidate: Authorised access to the user’s own alert mailbox avoids manual pasting; resolve the content-processing/reuse scope before treating it as a licensed integration.
recommended_access.licensed_route: Provider agreement for the actual local-agent workflow, or a separately licensed data supplier whose Zoopla rights explicitly cover it.

uncertainty: Current developer-home content was not readable; no categorical claim of API retirement or nonexistence.
Whether a particular statutory exception applies is separate from this provider-terms audit.
providers.legal_status: Published provider wording and bounded research findings; not a judicial enforceability determination or declaration of illegality.

providers.name: OnTheMarket

sources.title: Terms
sources.evidence: Clause 3.3 excepts a Permitted Program that uniquely identifies itself in User-Agent and fully follows the Robots Exclusion Protocol. Clause 2.2 separately restricts storage, copying and reuse beyond downloading for site use. Clauses 3.4–3.5 restrict external/deep links and framing. Security circumvention is prohibited; registration is single-user.

sources.title: Robots rules incorporated by terms clause 3.3
sources.evidence: Rules differ by crawler. Generic exclusions include many price/bedroom/radius/property-type/map query combinations, contact/account routes, some property-image/floorplan/EPC routes and agent-website redirects. The observed generic group does not blanket-disallow every property-detail page. Robots is relevant because clause 3.3 incorporates it, not because robots independently grants reuse rights.

sources.title: How to use OnTheMarket’s tools; dated 10 August 2026
sources.clause: 5. Set up instant property alerts; saved favourites
sources.evidence: Official tools include saved favourites and instant alerts for matching listings, price reductions and availability changes. This describes a consumer feature, not an external-agent content licence.

sources.title: Homepage
sources.evidence: The homepage offers Buy/Rent matching alerts delivered to the subscriber’s inbox.

sources.title: Only With Us: advertiser guide
sources.clause: How can you list your properties as Only With Us?
sources.evidence: Agents can upload their own properties through OnTheMarket Expert or a feed provider. This is an advertiser upload route, not an all-market search API.

user_directed_agent_browser.note: Same clause 3.3 test; no separate exemption.

reuse.note: Access does not establish private-report/caching rights.

api.note: No public rental-search API licence established.

alerts.note: Own-mailbox ingestion remains a candidate with unresolved downstream content scope.

export_feed.note: Advertiser feed direction is into the portal.

access_eligibility_and_fees.permitted_program: See otm-terms clause 3.3; fee not stated.
access_eligibility_and_fees.alerts: Consumer subscription/account route; separate alert fee not stated in reviewed sources.
access_eligibility_and_fees.advertiser_feed: Participating advertiser and supported feed provider; fees unknown.

recommended_access.now: Assess the conditional reader alongside independently authorised original-agent sources.
recommended_access.no_paste_candidate: Conditional reader or official alerts; downstream reuse unresolved.
recommended_access.licensed_route: Clarify or license the separate reuse gap.

uncertainty: No particular host or URL sequence cleared.
Private local report treatment needs assessment.

providers.name: OpenRent

sources.title: Terms & Conditions
sources.clause: General terms: Your obligations and conduct, nested 1.1.5 and 1.1.7; 1.2; landlord content licence 5.7
sources.evidence: Terms prohibit using software or other means to harvest information and copying website material without permission. Credentials must be secured. A landlord’s licence to OpenRent is not a general licence to unrelated consumers or tool publishers.

sources.title: How do the search bar and email alerts work?
sources.clause: How do I find the newest properties available?
sources.evidence: The official search offers Create Email Alert under the map. Matching new-property messages are sent up to once daily. Listings connect directly with landlords.

sources.title: How do I set up an email alert?
sources.evidence: An official alert setup tutorial exists; its embedded video was not analysed. The substantive procedure is supported by or-alerts.

user_directed_agent_browser.note: Terms do not define whether each isolated assistive read is harvesting; no affirmative local-agent carveout found.

reuse.note: No independent permission for persistent cache, copied advert text/images or report republication verified.

api.note: Official-domain API/feed searches and reviewed help/terms did not establish a rental-search API licence; this is not proof none exists.

alerts.note: Permission to create/receive alerts does not establish a downstream automation or reuse licence.

export_feed.note: No official consumer rental export/feed documentation located.

access_eligibility_and_fees.alerts: Consumer search alert signup; any separate fees or enhanced-tier conditions were not established in the reviewed guide.

recommended_access.now: Use official personal search alerts. Original landlord websites are an option only where they actually exist and independently permit the intended use; OpenRent is frequently the direct landlord source.
recommended_access.no_paste_candidate: The user’s own authorised mailbox can supply received alerts without copying and pasting; permission for extracting/caching their content remains unresolved.
recommended_access.licensed_route: Provider permission for the concrete local reading/report workflow, or an independently authorised landlord source.

uncertainty: No complete approved automated discovery-to-report path established.
A blanket claim that every AI-assisted read is illegal would go beyond these terms.
Do not promise an original letting-agent page for a direct-landlord listing.

providers.name: SpareRoom

sources.title: Terms
sources.evidence: Registration/search are free. Software or other integrations need express written consent; harvesting and unauthorised integrations are prohibited. Personal noncommercial viewing/downloading/printing is conditional: no inclusion in another work, alteration or third-party distribution. Managed Service serves large advertisers, under extra terms and separate pricing; it is not a consumer search feed.

sources.title: Why set up email alerts?
sources.evidence: Completing a search profile, with an optional Room Wanted ad, enables daily summaries of matching ads from the prior 24 hours and instant alerts. Preferences can be changed in the account. Posting a public wanted ad is not presented as mandatory.

automation.note: The integration restriction matters even where code never calls itself a scraper.

user_directed_agent_browser.note: A site-specific agent integration needs consent under the wording; incidental general assistive reading is not separately defined.

reuse.note: A personal-use label alone does not clear report copies or cached/reproduced advert images.

api.note: No public rental-search API licence found. Advertiser managed services do not establish one.

alerts.note: Agent extraction and reuse of delivered content are not licensed expressly by the alert help page.

export_feed.note: No consumer data-export route verified for finding other people’s current adverts.

access_eligibility_and_fees.alerts: Search profile; optional Room Wanted ad; separate fee not stated in reviewed help page.
access_eligibility_and_fees.managed_service: Large advertisers, provider discretion, extra terms and separate pricing; actual fee unknown.
access_eligibility_and_fees.integration_permission: Express written consent; eligibility and fees unknown.

recommended_access.now: Use official personal alerts/search. Independently permitted original advertiser pages are an alternative only when available.
recommended_access.no_paste_candidate: Use an authorised personal mail connector for received alerts only after resolving the scope of automated processing/reuse; a public Room Wanted ad need not be created for this research.
recommended_access.licensed_route: Express consent for the proposed integration plus sufficient content-use rights, rather than relying on free membership.

uncertainty: An advertiser’s own upload/managed account does not establish access to everyone else’s listings.
Many room adverts have no separate original-agent page.
No complete licensed local-agent workflow was established.
providers.legal_status: Published provider wording and bounded research findings; not a judicial enforceability determination or declaration of illegality.
